summary: Router 0.42.17 implements TM-07's cross-check of plausible but false reports, as kay asked (ADR-0142, proposed). Traced B3: an approved agent's heartbeat goes through poll.apply_heartbeat (ADR-0137 range checks first); after the GPU facts it now calls note_report_contradictions. report_contradictions compares (1) the reported free VRAM with total minus the size_vram of the models the same agent reports loaded (node.loaded, GiB), plus 1 GiB slack, only when loaded <= total (a second GPU the agent does not report would otherwise look like a lie), and (2) the reported GPU utilisation (<= 2 %) with Node.last_output_at, which the relay stamps in its native stream loop when a non-empty output line arrives from the node - the router's own observation, not an agent value - within two heartbeat intervals plus 2 s; not for gpu_present false. A contradiction counts after 3 consecutive heartbeats (load/unload tails and sampling lag do not), then Node.report_mismatch (snapshot), problems agent_free_vram_mismatch / agent_idle_while_generating (catalogue with de/en templates; parameters are numbers, the node name goes through the existing make/format path), one log warning and one audit line agent_report_mismatch (bounded: once per contradiction, cleared with the first agreeing heartbeat). Routing and node state are untouched (operator decides; revoke). No new exception path; heartbeats of unapproved tunnels never reach apply_heartbeat.

tests.evidence: 5 tests: free VRAM above the room next to the loaded models found, within slack not, loaded > card (second GPU) and nothing loaded not; idle GPU while output arrived 1 s ago found, busy GPU, no recent output and gpu_present false not; persistence: nothing after 2 heartbeats, fact + one warning + one audit line on the 3rd, no second audit line on the 4th, problem and node view present, node state unchanged, cleared by an agreeing heartbeat (rejected cases); both kinds raise their own problem with the English text; the relay stamps last_output_at in its stream loop. With poll.py, nodes.py, proxy.py and problems.py from origin/main: 1 failure, 4 errors.
scenario raises both new codes; catalogue checks (de/en, severity) pass.

tests.command: every python test/... and tools/... command of all workflows in .github/workflows/, except run_tests.py and check_public_changes; plus ruff check . and router.py --check router/config.example.yaml --pure

tests.evidence: 337 PASS, 0 failures; no contradiction raised by its heartbeats.

limitations: A consistent liar passes: free VRAM that fits its own false loaded list, or a false utilisation while generating.
A node whose Ollama works on a second GPU the agent does not report raises agent_idle_while_generating.
Only the native stream path stamps last_output_at; unary answers and OpenAI-compatible nodes are not observed this way.
